questions.q: What illness does Holden contract during his New York trip?
questions.why: Holden catches pneumonia while wandering New York.

questions.q: Which museum does Holden enjoy visiting?
questions.why: He loves the Museum of Natural History.

questions.q: What does Holden order at the Edmont hotel that leads to a panic?
questions.why: He orders a prostitute, Sunny, and panics when she arrives.

questions.q: Which sibling does Holden want to give a record to?
questions.why: He plans to deliver a record to his sister Phoebe.

questions.q: What theme is highlighted by Holden's reluctance to take risks?
questions.why: His hesitation reflects the struggle to form an identity.
